retrievalProfile.description: A two-part vertical composition featuring a saturated magenta header with heavy slab-serif typography over a soft-focus profile portrait.
triggerTerms: magenta header with white slab serif text
profile portrait with outdoor bokeh background

recipe.visualDefinition: A square layout divided into a top third magenta text block and a bottom two-thirds photographic section. The header uses high-contrast, heavy-weight slab serifs in white and cyan, while the photograph features a warm-toned profile of a subject against a blurred natural background.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal division between solid color header and photographic base
Color contrast between magenta background and cyan/white text
Symmetry in the header text columns separated by a thin vertical line
Subject profile facing left to create lead-in space
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif display type in the top header
Saturated magenta color block for the upper third
Soft-focus naturalistic background in the lower photographic section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject in profile, positioned in the lower right quadrant, looking toward the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white slab-serif title text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top-left text, moves across the header to the right, then drops to the subject's face and follows their gaze left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred background space to the left of the subject's profile.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header contrasting with muted, warm natural tones in the photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and bold grotesque
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for titles paired with bold sans-serif for lists, using color to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style.
Matches the secondary bold sans-serif lists.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a saturated magenta rectangle covering the top 35%. The bottom 65% should be a warm-toned profile photograph of a person looking left against a blurred green and yellow forest background. Apply a subtle weathered paper texture across the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two columns of text in the magenta block. Use a heavy white slab-serif for the top titles and a bold cyan sans-serif for the lists below. Separate the columns with a thin cyan vertical line.

verificationChecks: Is the main title a heavy slab-serif?
Is the subject in profile in the lower section?
Are there two distinct columns of text in the header?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is contained within the magenta block.
Ensure the slab-serif is sufficiently heavy and blocky.
Verify the profile portrait has a soft-focus background.
Confirm the cyan and white color scheme for text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Color] header block with [Heavy Slab Serif] text over a [Subject] [Profile] photograph with [Blurred Background] and [Weathered Texture].
